(EN)L’CARLIE Sunacnea is a plant-based, broad-spectrum sunscreen specially developed for sensitive and acne-prone skin. Enriched with tamanu, pomegranate, grape seed, myrrh, sandalwood, and aronia ferment, it helps maintain skin’s moisture balance and supports protection against environmental factors. Formulated with non-nano zinc oxide, it offers SPF 30 protection against UVA and UVB rays. With regular use, it contributes to a stronger skin barrier.
